nodes.title: Enter Positive Prompt Here
widgets_values: A photorealistic illustration of a majestic orange tabby cat in a tuxedo.

Composition: The image features an elderly mouse sitting on a large mushroom in the center of a forest glade. The mouse is dressed in vintage elderly clothes, complete with an old hat, and a cane resting by his side. Above him, a thought bubble showcases a younger version of himself, full of energy and mischief, leaping and playing.

Lighting: Soft, dappled sunlight filters through the trees, casting gentle shadows and creating a serene atmosphere. The lighting highlights the textures of the mouse's clothing and the vibrant colors of the forest.

Design: The forest glade is lush and green, with a variety of plants and flowers surrounding the mushroom. The thought bubble is subtly integrated into the scene, with a dreamy, ethereal quality.

Style: The image is rendered in a whimsical, storybook style, with attention to detail and a touch of nostalgia.

Camera Lens Information: A 50mm lens is used to capture the scene, providing a natural perspective and focusing on the mouse's contemplative expression.

Camera Angle: The camera is positioned at a low angle, slightly below eye level with the mouse, emphasizing his thoughtful demeanor and the grandeur of the forest around him.

Time of Day: The scene is set in the late afternoon, with warm, golden light enhancing the peaceful mood.

Detailed Description of Character and Emotion: The elderly mouse exudes wisdom and reflection, his eyes soft and thoughtful as he reminisces about his adventurous past. The younger mouse in the thought bubble is full of life and joy, capturing the essence of carefree youth. The overall emotion of the image is gentle and thought-provoking, inviting viewers to reflect on the passage of time and the richness of life experiences.

Create a photorealistic image of a US Navy Sturgeon-class submarine broaching out of the water at a very steep angle. The composition should capture the dynamic motion of the submarine as it emerges from the ocean, with water cascading off its hull. Use dramatic lighting to highlight the sleek design of the submarine, emphasizing its powerful presence. The style should be realistic, with attention to detail in the textures of the submarine and the ocean. Use a wide-angle lens to capture the full scale of the scene, with a low camera angle to enhance the sense of power and motion. Set the scene during the golden hour, either at sunrise or sunset, to add warmth and contrast to the image. The submarine should appear formidable and majestic, evoking a sense of awe and respect for its engineering and capabilities.
